summary: chore(content-server): remove Backbone-era config, grunt tasks and assets
description:
Because:

* The Backbone app is gone, but content-server still holds config,
  grunt tasks, plugins and assets that only it used.

This commit:

* Removes 7 unused config keys and the jsResourcePath production block
* Deletes 14 unused grunt tasks and their 7 grunt plugins
* Deletes rpm-version.js, the fontello fonts and their build globs
* Deletes 4 unused Tailwind CSS files, their config entries and SVGs

Closes FXA-14845
